ITEM 1A.RISK FACTORS
Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below, which could harm our business, financial condition, and operating results.
Risks Specific to our Company
We generate most of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, or new technologies that block advertisements online could harm our business and operating results.
Advertisers can terminate their contracts with us at any time, and expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions. Adverse macroeconomic conditions could reduce advertising demand and harm our financial condition and operating results.
Changes to advertising policies and data privacy practices could limit the advertising services we are able to provide, and technologies that block the display of advertisements could impair the availability of our advertising products.
We face intense competition. If we do not continue to innovate and provide products and services that are useful to users, customers, and partners, we may not remain competitive, which could harm our business, financial condition, and operating results.
Our businesses are rapidly evolving and intensely competitive, and we face formidable competition in every aspect of our business, including from companies that have greater resources in particular markets. Competitive pressure could reduce our market share and our margins over

Our indebtedness and future financing needs could adversely affect our liquidity, and changes in interest rates could increase our borrowing costs.
We have outstanding debt and may incur additional indebtedness. Higher interest rates could increase the cost of refinancing that debt, reduce our liquidity, and limit the capital available to invest in our business or return to stockholders.
